scope: Source inventory and observed local acceptance; production and physical devices are separate gates

features.name: Family Home Dashboard
features.role: Each user owns their Home preferences. Shared entries and music remain subject to current library permissions.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Family Shelves
features.role: Only the owner edits the shelf. A shared recipient can read allowed content; an administrator does not gain access to another adult’s private shelf.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Family Music Time Capsule
features.role: Private by default; explicit recipients and current library access are checked again when reading attachments.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Music Letters
features.role: Drafts are private to their author. Scheduled letters are hidden from recipients until delivery. Recipient access and attachment authorization are enforced on the server.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Family Music Requests
features.role: Drafts remain private. Submitted requests go to server-derived administrator recipients; regular members cannot perform administrator status transitions.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Forgotten Albums
features.role: Suggestions and dismissals are personal and filtered by current library permissions.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Music Quality Passport
features.role: Only currently authorized catalog references resolve. Secret source paths, credentials and remote object URLs are not part of the passport.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Library Doctor
features.role: Administrator only. Protected child accounts cannot access diagnostic jobs or diagnostic audio leases.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Version Collector
features.role: Catalog permissions are rechecked. Preferences are per user and cannot grant access to an otherwise private library.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Kids Music World
features.role: No child account is created automatically. Library access and server route guards apply even when calling APIs directly. Sharing with other adults is off unless explicitly enabled by the parent.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.

features.name: Family Legacy Export
features.role: An administrator cannot export another adult’s private records. Permissions are checked again at download and attachment reads. The link belongs to the preparing account.
features.config: Per-user preferences or explicit form settings
features.evidence: 191 guarded local HTTP checks across four acceptance suites; Go and UI regression suites. Production release candidate not deployed.
